modalLead: Config overview is sharper: six headline tiles including monitored bookmarks, a new-features carousel, and a tidier panel layout. Layout and Display live under Appearance now; bookmarks gain page-scoped categories and shareable page filters. The dashboard header shows where you are in config, health, or inbox. Config remembers your place only when you leave via Shift+H or Shift+I.

items.text: Overview headline tiles — six compact tiles on one row, including a Monitored count that opens Health on the monitored filter when clicked (overviewTiles, monitoredCount on the health summary).
New features carousel — Config → Overview spotlights one release highlight at a time with ‹ › navigation, a counter, and keyboard ←/→ (overviewNewFeatures).
Overview panel layout — About the developer and Latest update sit side by side at half width; Tips spans the row below. Needs-attention stays visually separate from the carousel.

Layout & Display under Appearance — grid structure, columns, density, toolbar visibility, and bookmark row display moved out of Behavior into Appearance → Layout and Appearance → Display. Legacy #config/behavior/layout and #config/behavior/display links redirect.

Page-scoped bookmark categories — the Bookmarks page filter scopes categories per page, shows Page · Category labels with All pages, adds a page badge per row, and deep-links with #config/bookmarks/<pageId>. Bulk category moves respect the selected pages.
Header breadcrumb — while config, health, or inbox is open, the large dashboard title reads config › bookmarks, health › broken, or similar — including config sub-tabs and the bookmarks page filter.
No duplicate config breadcrumb — the small trail inside the config panel is gone; the section title (Bookmarks, Appearance, …) remains.
Config location memory — your section and sub-tab are remembered only when you leave config via Shift+H or Shift+I. Escape and 0–9 clear stored location so the next visit starts on Overview.
Setting promos — one-time balloons for Find settings and the Bookmarks page filter (config-setting-promos.js).
monitoredCount on the health summary — the bookmark-health API reports how many bookmarks have monitoring enabled, feeding the config overview tile without scanning every issue row.

Help, MANUAL, and Overview — Config → Help → What's new, MANUAL.md, README, CHANGELOG, and Config → Overview → Latest update describe this patch. Playwright specs cover appearance tabs, overview layout, monitored tile, bookmarks page filters, and legacy hash migration.
